name: Mara Lindqvist
role: Senior Data Scientist at Fernhollow Logistics (fictional)
bio: Fictional eval persona. Seven years in applied data science, the last four forecasting freight demand at Fernhollow Logistics, a made-up regional freight company. Cares more about models that survive production than models that win offline benchmarks.
writing_rules: Lead with the concrete number or failure, not the lesson
One technical term per paragraph, explained in plain words
target_audience: Data scientists and analytics engineers two to five years into their careers
opinions: A forecast nobody acts on is a dashboard, not a model
Most A/B test mistakes are stopping rules, not statistics
Feature stores are worth it only once two teams share features
writing_samples: We shipped a model that was 4% better offline and 11% worse in December. Offline, December did not exist. That was the whole bug.
I used to think data contracts were bureaucracy. Then an upstream team renamed one column and our forecast quietly predicted zero trucks for a week.
